description: Use for debugging an x402 client: pay $0.001 in USDC (or USDT0 on Arbitrum) on any network in accepts and get back what the server received: the decoded payment payload. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /x402-echo, $0.001 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge.
name: x402_echo
title: x402 echo
